# chat-human

> `NB-Corp/chat-human` (`v0.2.0`, MIT License) is a standalone, persona-agnostic Agent Skill for Personal Agents (`OpenClaw`, `AstrBot`, `Claude Code`, `Codex`, `Cursor`, `skills.sh`, `ClawHub`) and mobile IM bots (`Telegram`, `WhatsApp`, `WeChat`, `QQ`, `Feishu/Lark`, `Discord`, `Slack`). While prose humanizers (`humanizer`) edit essays, `chat-human` stops Personal Agents from turning chat windows into 200-word corporate memos and raw `|---|---|` Markdown pipe-table dumps—separating **Layer 1 Universal Mobile IM Bubble Physics** (1–4 short thumb-typed beats, code/SQL/table card offload, zero trailing periods on short lines or pickup codes, pure text by default with strictly opt-in final-bubble voice notes, and silence-decay outreach) from **Layer 2 Pluggable Persona & Mood Adaptation**, backed by zero-dependency Python 3.10+ stdlib `bubble_lint.py` and `proactive_gate.py`.

## Quickstart Across Personal Agents & Runtimes

- `npx skills add NB-Corp/chat-human --global --agent '*'` (or Claude Code `/plugin marketplace add NB-Corp/chat-human`) — Install the standalone `chat-human` Agent Skill into Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Kiki, Gemini CLI, and 70+ Agent Skills (`skills.sh`) runtimes.
- `npx -y github:NB-Corp/nb-speak mcp` — Mount `@nb-corp/nb-speak-mcp` (`io.github.NB-Corp/nb-speak`) in Cursor, Windsurf, Cherry Studio, Cline, Roo Code, Goose, Zed, and Raycast.
- `npx --yes github:NB-Corp/nb-speak openclaw --apply` — Zero-clone installation of `@nb-corp/nb-speak-openclaw`, fixing Telegram/WhatsApp raw pipe tables (`openclaw#36323`) and 250-word essay regressions.
- `https://github.com/NB-Corp/astrbot_plugin_nb_speak` & `https://github.com/NB-Corp/langbot_plugin_nb_speak` — Native AstrBot v4+ & LangBot v4+ plugins for QQ/WeChat/Feishu/DingTalk, alongside `koishi-plugin-nb-speak`, `nonebot-plugin-nb-speak`, OpenWebUI `nb_speak_filter.py`, and `nb-speak serve`.

- [English README](https://github.com/NB-Corp/chat-human/blob/main/README.md): Personal Agent positioning, Before/After mobile IM table, two-layer architecture, and CLI usage.
- [中文文档 (README.zh-CN.md)](https://github.com/NB-Corp/chat-human/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md): 面向 OpenClaw / AstrBot / 微信 / QQ / Telegram 的短气泡物理层与防破功指南。
- [`skills/chat-human/SKILL.md`](https://github.com/NB-Corp/chat-human/blob/main/skills/chat-human/SKILL.md): Full Agent Skill prompt contract & pre-send verification rules.
- [`references/bubble-and-voice-patterns.md`](https://github.com/NB-Corp/chat-human/blob/main/skills/chat-human/references/bubble-and-voice-patterns.md): 10 AI chat tells, dual surfaces (`send_message` vs plain `\n\n`), and opt-in spoken TTS prosody.
- [`references/persona-and-mood-physics.md`](https://github.com/NB-Corp/chat-human/blob/main/skills/chat-human/references/persona-and-mood-physics.md): 4-level persona priority, 4 archetype comparisons, and mood-decay multipliers.
- [Full Reference for LLMs (`llms-full.txt`)](https://github.com/NB-Corp/chat-human/blob/main/llms-full.txt): Complete `bubble_lint.py` 8-rule specification, `proactive_gate.py` exit codes, and PA integration matrix.
